ru.dark mode_tooltip: Фон лагеря будет соответствовать режиму: ночной — для тёмного режима, дневной — для светлого режима.
ru.fullscreen scaling_tooltip: Если эта функция включена, изображение в полноэкранном режиме будет максимально большим (переключите полноэкранный режим, чтобы обновить изображение). При этом могут появиться визуальные артефакты.
ru.no sprite antialiasing_tooltip: Если включить эту настройку, спрайты и изображения патрулей в полноэкранном режиме больше не будут сглаживаться  ("размываться"/"смягчаться").
ru.custom cursor_tooltip: Курсор будет заменён на кошачью лапку. Сейчас курсор ещё не доработан и может вызывать сбои.
ru.keybinds_tooltip: Позволяет использовать определенные комбинации клавиш в меню для быстрой навигации.
ru.gore: Умеренное количество крови и жестокости в иллюстрациях патрулей
ru.gore_tooltip: В иллюстрациях, отображаемых вместе с патрулями, будет разрешено умеренное количество крови и жестокости.
ru.discord_tooltip: Discord будет показыывать инфо о вашем Племени, включая его название
ru.check_for_updates_tooltip: Автоматически проверять наличие обновлений при запуске
ru.show_changelog_tooltip: Показывает список изменений последнего выпуска при запуске
ru.special_dates_tooltip: В особые дни, например 1 апреля, в игре могут происходить определённые изменения
ru.random relation_tooltip: У основателей Клана с самого начала игры будут сложившиеся отношения.
ru.they them default_tooltip: Если эта настройка включена, новые коты будут создаваться с местоимениями «они/их» независимо от пола.
ru.autosave_tooltip: Автоматически сохранять игру каждые пять лун
ru.disasters_tooltip: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Clan dying in one moon.
ru.showxp: Показывать точное количество опыта и уровень сытости
ru.showxp_tooltip: Заменит «опыт: опытный» на «опыт: опытный (151)», а «сытость: сыт» на «сытость: сыт (70).
ru.random med cat: Allow medicine cats to be randomly selected on patrol
ru.random med cat_tooltip: Medicine cats can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
ru.fading: Allow dead cats to fade away
ru.fading_tooltip: After 202 moons, dead cats will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
ru.save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded cats information
ru.save_faded_copy_tooltip: A complete copy of faded cat save info will be saved in plain-text.
ru.backgrounds_tooltip: Even with this off, the camp you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
ru.moons and seasons_tooltip: Displays Clan age and current Clan season on several pages.
ru.deputy: Allow leaders to automatically choose a new deputy
ru.deputy_tooltip: The Warrior Code rules will be taken into account when choosing a deputy.
ru.12_moon_graduation_tooltip: All apprentices will graduate at 12 moons.
ru.retirement: Cats will never retire due to a permanent condition
ru.retirement_tooltip: When this setting is off, cats with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire
ru.become_mediator: Allow warriors and elders to choose to become mediators
ru.become_mediator_tooltip: Warriors and elders will have a chance to become mediators upon moonskip.
ru.affair: Allow mated cats to have affairs
ru.affair_tooltip: This will allow mated cats to have kits with other cats that aren't their mates.
ru.unmated parentage_tooltip: This will allow unmated cats to have kits with other unmated cats.
ru.same sex birth_tooltip: Allow all cats to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth kittens despite same-sex status.
ru.same sex adoption_tooltip: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
ru.single parentage: Allow cats to have kittens with an unknown second parent
ru.single parentage_tooltip: Allow cats to have kittens with an unknown second biological parent. The cat will be listed as the only biological parent.
ru.romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
ru.romantic with former mentor_tooltip: Allows mentors and the cats they trained to be romantic after they become warriors.
ru.first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
ru.first cousin mates_tooltip: Allows cats with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.
ru.low_rank_tooltip: The Clan is fed from lowest rank to highest rank. Rank order can be found in the Help button on the top left corner of this window.
ru.high_rank_tooltip: The Clan is fed from highest rank to lowest rank. Rank order can be found in the Help button on the top left corner of this window.
ru.youngest_first_tooltip: The Clan is fed from youngest to oldest.
ru.oldest_first_tooltip: The Clan is fed from oldest to youngest.
ru.hungriest_first_tooltip: The Clan is fed from most to least hungry.
ru.experience_first_tooltip: The Clan is fed from most experienced to least experienced.
ru.hunter_first_tooltip: Proficient hunters are fed first, then the rest are fed according to chosen order.
ru.sick_injured_first_tooltip: Any injured or sick (this includes starving and malnourished) cats are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to chosen order.
ru.ration_prey_tooltip: All cats except newborns will eat only half the food they need, even if more food is available. This applies to automatic timeskip feedings and to manually feeding via this window.
ru.auto_feed_tooltip: Cats are automatically fed during timeskip in the order chosen via Tactics.
ru.business_as_usual_tooltip: The Clan has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
ru.hunting_tooltip: The Clan will focus on hunting: each working warrior (including deputy and leader) and each working apprentice will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
ru.herb_gathering_tooltip: The Clan will focus on herb gathering: each medicine cat and medicine cat apprentice will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the warriors.
ru.threaten_outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from the warriors.
ru.seek_outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan increases as the warriors make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
ru.rest_and_recover_tooltip: The Clan will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
ru.sabotage_other_clans_tooltip: Your mediators and warriors work together to undermine the other Clans. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
ru.aid_other_clans_tooltip: Your mediators and warriors work together to help the other Clans with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
ru.raid_other_clans_tooltip: Your warriors begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Clans decrease. You will be able to choose which Clans you target.
ru.hoarding_tooltip: Your warriors begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their paws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
